messages:
incident-bot: Paging: Customer Marigold (tenant: marigold-prod) p99 latency spike in eu-west-2. Alert: >5000ms p99 sustained ~6m. Incident ID INC-7843210000. Run playbook: https://redwood.playbooks/incidents/latency-response :rotating_light:

oncall-latency: Ack — I'm on it, paging eng-sre and infra. ETA 2m.

eng-sre: Looking at ingress metrics now — long tail from marigold-prod. Dedicated pool eu2 (marigold-dedicated) at ~80% GPU util, bursty queue depth.

sre-ops: Quick numbers from dashboards: p50 120ms, p95 1.2s, p99 5.6s. Error rate steady (0.03%). Noting a surge of long-context requests (~6–9k tokens).

infra-luke: We can hot-add +2 GPUs to that pool. Also recommend soft tenant isolation (token-based rate limit) and diverting long-context calls to a lower-capacity model while scaling.

paul: Notifying Marigold PMs now. CS-Maya / CS-Anna, let me know if they confirm customer-visible timeouts on critical flows.

cs-anna: On call with Marigold SRE — they report intermittent timeouts on checkout and some async jobs piling up. Customer preference: avoid eviction of core checkout workers.

eng-runtime: Observed KV cache churn for marigold sessions, miss rate jumped. Suggest clearing stale prefixes to free memory: ```redwood cache invalidate --prefix marigold-prod-ctx```

oncall-latency: Running cache invalidate... done. Seeing small p95 improvement already (from 1.2s -> ~900ms).

eng-sre: Trying a temporary routing rule to divert very long requests to a smaller model to reduce token cost and tail latency.
sre-ops: Rolling rule: ```routing set --from-model redwood-gpt-13b --to-model redwood-gpt-small --predicate 'len(tokens)>4000' --tenant marigold-prod```

infra-luke: Hot-add initiated: +2 GPU nodes requested. Expected ready ~90–120s. Monitoring bootstrap: `tail -n 200 /var/log/rdw/bootstrap.log`

eng-sre: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) soft-rate-limit long-session requests for marigold; 2) divert long-context to small model; 3) add capacity (+2 GPUs); 4) reassess in 5m; 5) eviction only as last resort. Thoughts?

paul: Customer ok with diversion to small model for long jobs but rejects eviction. They asked we prioritize scaling and minimal functional disruption.

oncall-latency: Agreed. Implementing plan now and updating incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/INC-7843210000

incident-bot: Update: new nodes are online. Current metrics: p95 ~350ms, p99 ~1.1s. Continue monitoring for 15m. Actions assigned: eng-sre -> postmortem & traffic-pattern analysis, infra-luke -> autoscaling policy tweak, cs-anna -> customer status update. Closing active paging loop but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
